description: This file defines the ToDoItemControl class, a UI component for individual todo list items, handling states, events, and interactions within a TodoMVC application using Closure Library.

classes.name: todomvc.view.ToDoItemControl
classes.description: A UI control representing a single todo list item, managing states, events, and user interactions.

methods.name: enterDocument
methods.description: Sets up event listeners after the component's DOM is rendered, handling clicks, double-clicks, and keyup events for editing and toggling the todo item.

methods.name: getRenderer
methods.description: Returns the renderer instance used to render or decorate the component.

methods.name: handleMouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse up events on the control, toggling checked state or dispatching destroy event based on clicked element.

methods.name: setFocused
methods.description: Overrides default unfocus behavior; if unfocused with empty input, dispatches destroy event; otherwise updates content.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Overrides selection behavior; when selected, populates input with current content and focuses it.
